B2 visual re-review found that the image does not match its old 'man walking' title; adult evidence cannot be inferred from a mismatched title.
B2 two-person historical scene has no nonvisual adult evidence for every depicted person; it is quarantined rather than inferred safe.
B2 human-presence evidence is insufficient for approval; the cafe image has visible people without documented adult evidence.
B2 distant visible people conflict with the old no_person tag; B5 corrected source attribution is preserved here, but the image is not approved in r2.
B2 visible human-presence/no_person uncertainty in the rejected candidate requires quarantine pending a separate review.
The official source imposes usage/contact conditions, so Public Domain license closure fails despite the 82-year nonvisual age evidence.
